<?php

const LARGE_GLYPHS = [
    '\\sum' => ['\\--', ' > ', '/--'],
    '\\prod' => ['___', '| |', '| |'],
    '\\int' => [' /', ' |', '/ '],
];

function symbolType(string $symbol): string
{
    if (str_contains('+-*', $symbol))
        return 'binary';
    if (str_contains('=<>:', $symbol))
        return 'relation';
    if (str_contains('([', $symbol))
        return 'open';
    if (str_contains(')]!', $symbol))
        return 'close';
    if (str_contains(',;', $symbol))
        return 'punctuation';
    return 'ordinary';
}

final class Box
{
    public array $children = [], $strings = [];

    public function __construct(
        public int $width,
        public int $height,
        public int $baseline,
        public string $description,
    ) {}

    public function descent(): int
    {
        return $this->height - 1 - $this->baseline;
    }

    public function add(self $child, int $x, int $y, string $role = ''): void
    {
        $this->children[] = [$child, $x, $y, $role];
    }

    public function draw(string $text, int $x = 0, int $y = 0): void
    {
        $this->strings[] = [$text, $x, $y];
    }
}

function delimiterGlyph(string $delimiter, int $height): array
{
    if ($delimiter === '.')
        return [];
    $character = substr($delimiter, -1);
    if ($height === 1)
        return [$character];
    if (in_array($delimiter, ['[', ']', '|'], true))
        return array_fill(0, $height, $delimiter);
    $left = $delimiter === '(' || $delimiter === '\\{';
    $glyph = [$left ? '/' : '\\', ...array_fill(0, $height - 2, '|'), $left ? '\\' : '/'];
    if (($delimiter === '\\{' || $delimiter === '\\}') && $height >= 3)
        $glyph[intdiv($height - 1, 2)] = $left ? '<' : '>';
    return $glyph;
}

<?php

function walkBox(Box $box, int $x, int $y, int $level = 0, string $role = ''): Generator
{
    yield [$box, $x, $y, $level, $role];
    foreach ($box->children as [$child, $dx, $dy, $childRole])
        yield from walkBox($child, $x + $dx, $y + $dy, $level + 1, $childRole);
}

function drawBoxes(array $roots, int $width, int $height): array
{
    $grid = array_fill(0, $height, str_repeat(' ', $width));
    foreach ($roots as [$root, $rx, $ry])
        foreach (walkBox($root, $rx, $ry) as [$box, $x, $y])
            foreach ($box->strings as [$text, $dx, $dy])
                for ($i = 0; $i < strlen($text); ++$i)
                    if ($text[$i] !== ' ')
                        $grid[$y + $dy][$x + $dx + $i] = $text[$i];
    return array_map(fn($line) => rtrim($line, ' '), $grid);
}

function boxLines(array $roots): array
{
    $entries = [];
    foreach ($roots as [$root, $rx, $ry])
        foreach (walkBox($root, $rx, $ry) as [$box, $x, $y, $level, $role])
            $entries[] = [
                str_repeat('  ', $level)
                    . $role
                    . $box->description
                    . " x=$x y=$y w={$box->width} h={$box->height} b={$box->baseline}",
                $level,
                explode(' ', $box->description, 2)[0],
            ];
    return $entries;
}

<?php

const TYPES = ['ordinary', 'operator', 'binary', 'relation', 'open', 'close', 'punctuation'];

const SPACING = [
    [0,   1,   'B',  'R',  0,   0,    0],
    [1,   1,   null, 'R',  0,   0,    0],
    ['B', 'B', null, null, 'B', null, null],
    ['R', 'R', null, 0,    'R', 0,    0],
    [0,   0,   null, 0,    0,   0,    0],
    [0,   1,   'B',  'R',  0,   0,    0],
    ['P', 'P', null, 'P',  'P', 'P',  'P'],
];

function elementTypes(MathNode $node): array
{
    if ($node->kind === 'symbol')
        $kind = symbolType($node->value);
    elseif ($node->kind === 'command')
        $kind = symbolCommands()[$node->value][1];
    elseif ($node->kind === 'delim')
        return ['open', 'close'];
    elseif ($node->kind === 'script')
        return elementTypes($node->children[0]);
    elseif ($node->kind === 'overset' || $node->kind === 'underset')
        return elementTypes($node->children[1]);
    else
        $kind = 'ordinary';
    return [$kind, $kind];
}

function convertedTypes(array $nodes): array
{
    $result = array_map(elementTypes(...), $nodes);
    foreach ($result as $i => $unused) {
        if (
            $result[$i][0] === 'binary'
            && (
                $i === 0
                || in_array(
                    $result[$i - 1][1],
                    ['binary', 'operator', 'relation', 'open', 'punctuation'],
                    true,
                )
            )
        )
            $result[$i] = ['ordinary', 'ordinary'];
        if (
            $i > 0
            && in_array($result[$i][0], ['relation', 'close', 'punctuation'], true)
            && $result[$i - 1][1] === 'binary'
        )
            $result[$i - 1] = ['ordinary', 'ordinary'];
    }
    $n = count($result);
    if ($n && $result[$n - 1][1] === 'binary')
        $result[$n - 1] = ['ordinary', 'ordinary'];
    return $result;
}

function wordElement(MathNode $n): bool
{
    if ($n->kind === 'script')
        return wordElement($n->children[0]);
    return $n->kind === 'command' && (in_array(substr($n->value, 1), GREEK, true) || $n->value === '\\infty');
}

function alphanumeric(MathNode $n): bool
{
    if ($n->kind === 'identifier' || $n->kind === 'number' || wordElement($n))
        return true;
    if ($n->kind === 'script')
        return alphanumeric($n->children[0]);
    return (
        $n->kind === 'accent'
        && in_array($n->value, ['overline', 'hat', 'vec', 'dot', 'tilde'], true)
        && alphanumeric($n->children[0])
    );
}

function spacing(array $nodes, string $style, array $params): array
{
    $types = convertedTypes($nodes);
    $values = [
        'B' => $style === 'normal' ? $params['bin_space'] : 0,
        'R' => $style === 'normal' ? $params['rel_space'] : 0,
        'P' => $style === 'normal' ? $params['punct_space'] : 0,
    ];
    $gaps = [];
    for ($i = 0; $i < (count($nodes) - 1); ++$i) {
        $a = $nodes[$i];
        $b = $nodes[$i + 1];
        if (alphanumeric($a) && alphanumeric($b) && (wordElement($a) || wordElement($b)))
            $gaps[] = 1;
        else {
            $entry = SPACING[array_search($types[$i][1], TYPES, true)][array_search(
                $types[$i + 1][0],
                TYPES,
                true,
            )];
            $gaps[] = is_string($entry) ? $values[$entry] : $entry;
        }
    }
    return [$types, $gaps];
}

function rowBox(array $children, array $gaps, string $description = 'row', ?array $roles = null): Box
{
    $ascent = $descent = $width = 0;
    foreach ($children as $child) {
        $ascent = max($ascent, $child->baseline);
        $descent = max($descent, $child->descent());
        $width += $child->width;
    }
    $width += array_sum($gaps);
    $box = new Box($width, $ascent + $descent + 1, $ascent, $description);
    $x = 0;
    foreach ($children as $i => $child) {
        $box->add($child, $x, $ascent - $child->baseline, $roles[$i] ?? '');
        $x += $child->width + ($gaps[$i] ?? 0);
    }
    return $box;
}

<?php

const GREEK = [
    'alpha',
    'beta',
    'gamma',
    'delta',
    'epsilon',
    'zeta',
    'eta',
    'theta',
    'iota',
    'kappa',
    'lambda',
    'mu',
    'nu',
    'xi',
    'pi',
    'rho',
    'sigma',
    'tau',
    'upsilon',
    'phi',
    'chi',
    'psi',
    'omega',
    'Gamma',
    'Delta',
    'Theta',
    'Lambda',
    'Xi',
    'Pi',
    'Sigma',
    'Upsilon',
    'Phi',
    'Psi',
    'Omega',
];

const FUNCTIONS = ['sin', 'cos', 'tan', 'log', 'ln', 'exp', 'det', 'lim', 'max', 'min'];

const LARGE_OPERATORS = ['sum', 'prod', 'int'];

const ACCENTS = ['overline', 'hat', 'vec', 'dot', 'tilde', 'overbrace', 'underbrace'];

const CONSTRUCTS = ['frac', 'binom', 'overset', 'underset', 'sqrt', 'left', 'right'];

const RAW_COMMANDS = ['text', 'begin', 'end', 'tag', 'label', 'eqref'];

const ENVIRONMENTS = ['matrix', 'pmatrix', 'bmatrix', 'vmatrix', 'cases'];

function symbolCommands(): array
{
    static $table = null;
    if ($table !== null)
        return $table;
    $table = [];
    foreach (GREEK as $name)
        $table['\\' . $name] = [$name, 'ordinary'];
    foreach ([...FUNCTIONS, ...LARGE_OPERATORS] as $name)
        $table['\\' . $name] = [$name, 'operator'];
    return $table += [
        '\\cdot' => ['*', 'binary'],
        '\\times' => ['x', 'binary'],
        '\\pm' => ['+-', 'binary'],
        '\\mp' => ['-+', 'binary'],
        '\\leq' => ['<=', 'relation'],
        '\\geq' => ['>=', 'relation'],
        '\\neq' => ['!=', 'relation'],
        '\\approx' => ['~=', 'relation'],
        '\\to' => ['->', 'relation'],
        '\\infty' => ['oo', 'ordinary'],
        '\\ldots' => ['...', 'ordinary'],
        '\\cdots' => ['...', 'ordinary'],
        '\\quad' => ['  ', 'ordinary'],
        '\\,' => [' ', 'ordinary'],
        '\\{' => ['{', 'open'],
        '\\}' => ['}', 'close'],
    ];
}

final class FormulaError extends RuntimeException
{
    public function __construct(
        public int $column,
        string $message,
    ) {
        parent::__construct($message);
    }
}

final readonly class Token
{
    public function __construct(
        public string $kind,
        public string $value,
        public int $column,
    ) {}
}

function letter(string $ch): bool
{
    return $ch >= 'A' && $ch <= 'Z' || $ch >= 'a' && $ch <= 'z';
}

function digit(string $ch): bool
{
    return $ch >= '0' && $ch <= '9';
}

function tokenize(string $line): array
{
    $tokens = [];
    $i = 0;
    $n = strlen($line);
    $symbols = "+-*/=<>:()[],;.!|'";
    $commands = symbolCommands();
    while ($i < $n) {
        $ch = $line[$i];
        $column = $i + 1;
        if ($ch === ' ') {
            ++$i;
            continue;
        }
        if (letter($ch)) {
            $start = $i++;
            while ($i < $n && letter($line[$i]))
                ++$i;
            $tokens[] = new Token('identifier', substr($line, $start, $i - $start), $column);
            continue;
        }
        if (digit($ch)) {
            $start = $i++;
            while ($i < $n && digit($line[$i]))
                ++$i;
            if (($i + 1) < $n && $line[$i] === '.' && digit($line[$i + 1])) {
                $i += 2;
                while ($i < $n && digit($line[$i]))
                    ++$i;
            }
            $tokens[] = new Token('number', substr($line, $start, $i - $start), $column);
            continue;
        }
        if (str_contains($symbols, $ch) || str_contains('{}^_&', $ch)) {
            $tokens[] = new Token(str_contains($symbols, $ch) ? 'symbol' : $ch, $ch, $column);
            ++$i;
            continue;
        }
        if ($ch !== '\\')
            throw new FormulaError($column, 'invalid character ' . $ch);
        ++$i;
        if ($i < $n && str_contains('\\{},', $line[$i])) {
            $escaped = $line[$i++];
            $tokens[] = new Token($escaped === '\\' ? 'newline' : 'command', '\\' . $escaped, $column);
            continue;
        }
        $start = $i;
        while ($i < $n && letter($line[$i]))
            ++$i;
        $name = substr($line, $start, $i - $start);
        if ($name === '')
            throw new FormulaError($column, 'invalid command');
        if (in_array($name, RAW_COMMANDS, true)) {
            while ($i < $n && $line[$i] === ' ')
                ++$i;
            if ($i === $n || $line[$i] !== '{')
                throw new FormulaError($i + 1, 'expected {');
            $end = strpos($line, '}', $i + 1);
            if ($end === false)
                throw new FormulaError($column, 'unterminated argument');
            $argument = substr($line, $i + 1, $end - $i - 1);
            if (($name === 'begin' || $name === 'end') && !in_array($argument, ENVIRONMENTS, true))
                throw new FormulaError($column, 'unknown environment "' . $argument . '"');
            $tokens[] = new Token($name, $argument, $column);
            $i = $end + 1;
        } elseif (isset($commands['\\' . $name]))
            $tokens[] = new Token('command', '\\' . $name, $column);
        elseif (in_array($name, ACCENTS, true))
            $tokens[] = new Token('accent', $name, $column);
        elseif (in_array($name, CONSTRUCTS, true))
            $tokens[] = new Token($name, $name, $column);
        else
            throw new FormulaError($column, 'unknown command \\' . $name);
    }
    $tokens[] = new Token('eof', '', $n + 1);
    return $tokens;
}

<?php

foreach (['lexer', 'parser', 'boxes', 'layout', 'canvas'] as $module)
    require_once __DIR__ . "/$module.php";
const STACKED_COMMANDS = ['\\sum', '\\prod', '\\lim', '\\max', '\\min'];

const BRACE_ACCENTS = ['overbrace', 'underbrace'];

const DELIMITER_PAIRS = ['(' => ')', '[' => ']', '|' => '|', '\\{' => '\\}'];

final class Formula
{
    public array $nodes = [], $tokens = [], $warnings = [];
    public ?Token $tag = null, $label = null;
    public ?string $tagString = null;
    public ?array $error = null;

    public function __construct(
        public int $number,
        public string $line,
    ) {
        try {
            $this->tokens = tokenize($line);
            checkBraces($this->tokens);
            $parser = new FormulaParser($this->tokens);
            $this->nodes = $parser->parse();
            $this->tag = $parser->tag;
            $this->label = $parser->label;
        } catch (FormulaError $error) {
            $this->error = [$error->column, $error->getMessage()];
        }
    }
}

function referenceTable(array $formulas): array
{
    $counter = 0;
    foreach ($formulas as $f)
        if ($f->error === null) {
            if ($f->tag !== null)
                $f->tagString = '(' . $f->tag->value . ')';
            elseif ($f->label !== null)
                $f->tagString = '(' . ++$counter . ')';
        }
    $references = [];
    foreach ($formulas as $f)
        if ($f->error === null && $f->label !== null) {
            $label = $f->label;
            if (isset($references[$label->value]))
                $f->warnings[] = [$label->column, 'duplicate label "' . $label->value . '"'];
            else
                $references[$label->value] = $f->tagString;
        }
    return $references;
}

function walkNodes(MathNode $node): Generator
{
    yield $node;
    if ($node->kind === 'matrix') {
        foreach ($node->children as $row)
            foreach ($row as $cell)
                yield from walkNodes($cell);
    } else
        foreach ($node->children as $child)
            if ($child !== null)
                yield from walkNodes($child);
}

function collectWarnings(Formula $formula, array $references): void
{
    $names = [];
    foreach (array_keys(symbolCommands()) as $name)
        if (ctype_alpha(substr($name, 1)))
            $names[substr($name, 1)] = true;
    foreach ($formula->nodes as $element)
        foreach (walkNodes($element) as $n) {
            if ($n->kind === 'identifier' && isset($names[$n->value]))
                $formula->warnings[] = [$n->column, $n->value . ' is a command name; write \\' . $n->value];
            elseif ($n->kind === 'reference' && !isset($references[$n->value]))
                $formula->warnings[] = [$n->column, 'undefined reference "' . $n->value . '"'];
            elseif ($n->kind === 'delim') {
                [$left, $right] = $n->value;
                if ($left !== '.' && $right !== '.' && (DELIMITER_PAIRS[$left] ?? null) !== $right)
                    $formula->warnings[] = [$n->column, '\\left' . $left . ' closed by \\right' . $right];
            }
        }
    usort($formula->warnings, fn($a, $b) => $a[0] <=> $b[0]);
}

function center(Box $box, int $width): int
{
    return intdiv($width - $box->width, 2);
}

function drawDelimiter(Box $box, string $delimiter, int $x, int $height): void
{
    foreach (delimiterGlyph($delimiter, $height) as $y => $character)
        $box->draw($character, $x, $y);
}

function delimiterString(string $delimiter): string
{
    return $delimiter === '.' ? '' : substr($delimiter, -1);
}

final class Typesetter
{
    public function __construct(
        private array $params,
        private array $references,
    ) {}

    public function typeset(MathNode $n, string $style = 'normal'): Box
    {
        if (in_array($n->kind, [...ATOM_KINDS, 'reference'], true))
            return $this->atom($n, $style);
        return $this->{$n->kind}($n, $style);
    }

    private function atom(MathNode $n, string $style): Box
    {
        if ($n->kind === 'text') {
            $description = 'text "' . $n->value . '"';
            $display = $n->value;
        } elseif ($n->kind === 'reference') {
            $description = 'eqref "' . $n->value . '"';
            $display = $this->references[$n->value] ?? '(??)';
        } else {
            $description = 'atom "' . $n->value . '"';
            $display = $n->kind === 'command' ? symbolCommands()[$n->value][0] : $n->value;
        }
        if ($n->kind === 'command' && isset(LARGE_GLYPHS[$n->value]) && $style === 'normal') {
            $glyph = LARGE_GLYPHS[$n->value];
            $box = new Box(strlen($glyph[0]), 3, 1, $description);
            foreach ($glyph as $y => $line)
                $box->draw($line, 0, $y);
        } else {
            $box = new Box(strlen($display), 1, 0, $description);
            $box->draw($display);
        }
        return $box;
    }

    private function row(MathNode $n, string $style): Box
    {
        [, $gaps] = spacing($n->children, $style, $this->params);
        return rowBox(array_map(fn($child) => $this->typeset($child, $style), $n->children), $gaps);
    }

    private function script(MathNode $n, string $style): Box
    {
        [$baseNode, $subNode, $supNode] = $n->children;
        $base = $this->typeset($baseNode, $style);
        $sub = $subNode === null ? null : $this->typeset($subNode, 'script');
        $sup = $supNode === null ? null : $this->typeset($supNode, 'script');
        $sw = $sub?->width ?? 0;
        $sh = $sub?->height ?? 0;
        $pw = $sup?->width ?? 0;
        $ph = $sup?->height ?? 0;
        $stacked =
            $style === 'normal'
            && (
                $baseNode->kind === 'command'
                && in_array($baseNode->value, STACKED_COMMANDS, true)
                || $baseNode->kind === 'accent'
                && in_array($baseNode->value, BRACE_ACCENTS, true)
            );
        if ($stacked) {
            $w = max($base->width, $sw, $pw);
            $box = new Box($w, $ph + $base->height + $sh, $ph + $base->baseline, 'limits');
            $box->add($base, center($base, $w), $ph, 'base: ');
            if ($sub !== null)
                $box->add($sub, center($sub, $w), $ph + $base->height, 'sub: ');
            if ($sup !== null)
                $box->add($sup, center($sup, $w), 0, 'sup: ');
            return $box;
        }
        $tp = ($base->baseline === 0 ? -1 : 0) - $ph + 1;
        $ts = $base->descent() === 0 ? $base->height : $base->height - 1;
        $top = $sup === null ? 0 : min(0, $tp);
        $bottom = $sub === null ? $base->height - 1 : max($base->height - 1, $ts + $sh - 1);
        $box = new Box($base->width + max($sw, $pw), $bottom - $top + 1, $base->baseline - $top, 'scripts');
        $box->add($base, 0, -$top, 'base: ');
        if ($sub !== null)
            $box->add($sub, $base->width, $ts - $top, 'sub: ');
        if ($sup !== null)
            $box->add($sup, $base->width, $tp - $top, 'sup: ');
        return $box;
    }

    private function frac(MathNode $n, string $style): Box
    {
        [$numerator, $denominator] = array_map(fn($child) => $this->typeset($child, $style), $n->children);
        if ($style === 'normal') {
            $w = max($numerator->width, $denominator->width) + 2;
            $box = new Box($w, $numerator->height + 1 + $denominator->height, $numerator->height, 'frac');
            $box->add($numerator, center($numerator, $w), 0, 'num: ');
            $box->add($denominator, center($denominator, $w), $numerator->height + 1, 'den: ');
            $box->draw(str_repeat('-', $w), 0, $numerator->height);
            return $box;
        }
        if (in_array($n->children[0]->kind, ['row', 'frac'], true))
            $numerator = $this->delimit($numerator, '(', ')');
        if (in_array($n->children[1]->kind, ['row', 'frac'], true))
            $denominator = $this->delimit($denominator, '(', ')');
        $slash = new Box(1, 1, 0, 'atom "/"');
        $slash->draw('/');
        return rowBox([$numerator, $slash, $denominator], [0, 0], 'slash', ['num: ', '', 'den: ']);
    }

    private function binom(MathNode $n, string $style): Box
    {
        [$upper, $lower] = array_map(fn($child) => $this->typeset($child, $style), $n->children);
        $w = max($upper->width, $lower->width);
        $h = $upper->height + 1 + $lower->height;
        $box = new Box($w + 2, $h, $upper->height, 'binom');
        $box->add($upper, center($upper, $w) + 1, 0, 'upper: ');
        $box->add($lower, center($lower, $w) + 1, $upper->height + 1, 'lower: ');
        drawDelimiter($box, '(', 0, $h);
        drawDelimiter($box, ')', $w + 1, $h);
        return $box;
    }

    private function overset(MathNode $n, string $style): Box
    {
        return $this->placed($n, $style, true);
    }

    private function underset(MathNode $n, string $style): Box
    {
        return $this->placed($n, $style, false);
    }

    private function placed(MathNode $n, string $style, bool $over): Box
    {
        $placed = $this->typeset($n->children[0], 'script');
        $base = $this->typeset($n->children[1], $style);
        $w = max($placed->width, $base->width);
        $box = new Box(
            $w,
            $placed->height + $base->height,
            $base->baseline + ($over ? $placed->height : 0),
            $over ? 'overset' : 'underset',
        );
        if ($over) {
            $box->add($placed, center($placed, $w), 0, 'over: ');
            $box->add($base, center($base, $w), $placed->height, 'base: ');
        } else {
            $box->add($base, center($base, $w), 0, 'base: ');
            $box->add($placed, center($placed, $w), $base->height, 'under: ');
        }
        return $box;
    }

    private function radical(Box $body, ?Box $index = null): Box
    {
        $k = $body->height;
        $e = $index === null ? 0 : max(0, $index->width - 1);
        $top = $index === null ? 0 : max(0, $index->height - $k);
        $box = new Box(
            $e + $k + 1 + $body->width,
            $k + 1 + $top,
            $body->baseline + 1 + $top,
            $index === null ? 'sqrt' : 'root',
        );
        $box->draw(str_repeat('_', $body->width), $e + $k + 1, $top);
        $box->draw('\\', $e, $k + $top);
        for ($r = 1; $r <= $k; ++$r)
            $box->draw('/', $e + $k - $r + 1, $r + $top);
        if ($index !== null) {
            $box->add($index, 0, $k - $index->height + $top, 'index: ');
            $box->add($body, $e + $k + 1, 1 + $top, 'body: ');
        } else
            $box->add($body, $e + $k + 1, 1);
        return $box;
    }

    private function sqrt(MathNode $n, string $style): Box
    {
        return $this->radical($this->typeset($n->children[0], $style));
    }

    private function root(MathNode $n, string $style): Box
    {
        return $this->radical(
            $this->typeset($n->children[1], $style),
            $this->typeset($n->children[0], 'script'),
        );
    }

    private function delimit(Box $body, string $left, string $right): Box
    {
        $wl = $left === '.' ? 0 : 1;
        $wr = $right === '.' ? 0 : 1;
        $box = new Box($wl + $body->width + $wr, $body->height, $body->baseline, "delim $left $right");
        $box->add($body, $wl, 0);
        drawDelimiter($box, $left, 0, $body->height);
        drawDelimiter($box, $right, $wl + $body->width, $body->height);
        return $box;
    }

    private function delim(MathNode $n, string $style): Box
    {
        return $this->delimit($this->typeset($n->children[0], $style), ...$n->value);
    }

    private function matrix(MathNode $n, string $style): Box
    {
        $cells = array_map(fn($row) => array_map(fn($cell) => $this->typeset(
            $cell,
            $style,
        ), $row), $n->children);
        $rows = count($cells);
        $cols = count($cells[0]);
        $widths = $ascents = $heights = [];
        for ($j = 0; $j < $cols; ++$j)
            $widths[] = max(array_map(fn($row) => $row[$j]->width, $cells));
        foreach ($cells as $row) {
            $ascent = max(array_map(fn($cell) => $cell->baseline, $row));
            $descent = max(array_map(fn($cell) => $cell->descent(), $row));
            $ascents[] = $ascent;
            $heights[] = $ascent + $descent + 1;
        }
        $cg = $this->params['col_gap'];
        $rg = $this->params['row_gap'];
        $wb = array_sum($widths) + ($cg * ($cols - 1));
        $hb = array_sum($heights) + ($rg * ($rows - 1));
        $environment = $n->value;
        $shift = $environment === 'matrix' ? 0 : 2;
        $extra = $environment === 'matrix' ? 0 : ($environment === 'cases' ? 2 : 4);
        $box = new Box($wb + $extra, $hb, intdiv($hb - 1, 2), "$environment rows=$rows cols=$cols");
        $y = 0;
        foreach ($cells as $i => $row) {
            $x = $shift;
            foreach ($row as $j => $cell) {
                $offset = $environment === 'cases' ? 0 : center($cell, $widths[$j]);
                $box->add(
                    $cell,
                    $x + $offset,
                    $y + $ascents[$i] - $cell->baseline,
                    'cell ' . ($i + 1) . ',' . ($j + 1) . ': ',
                );
                $x += $widths[$j] + $cg;
            }
            $y += $heights[$i] + $rg;
        }
        if ($environment === 'cases')
            drawDelimiter($box, '\\{', 0, $hb);
        elseif ($environment !== 'matrix') {
            [$left, $right] = [
                'pmatrix' => ['(', ')'],
                'bmatrix' => ['[', ']'],
                'vmatrix' => ['|', '|'],
            ][$environment];
            drawDelimiter($box, $left, 0, $hb);
            drawDelimiter($box, $right, $wb + 3, $hb);
        }
        return $box;
    }

    private function accent(MathNode $n, string $style): Box
    {
        $body = $this->typeset($n->children[0], $style);
        $name = $n->value;
        $w = $body->width;
        if (in_array($name, ['hat', 'dot', 'tilde'], true))
            $w = max($w, 1);
        elseif ($name === 'vec')
            $w = max($w, 2);
        elseif (in_array($name, BRACE_ACCENTS, true))
            $w += 2;
        $box = new Box($w, $body->height + 1, $body->baseline + ($name === 'underbrace' ? 0 : 1), $name);
        if ($name === 'underbrace') {
            $box->add($body, 1, 0);
            $box->draw('\\' . str_repeat('-', $body->width) . '/', 0, $body->height);
        } elseif ($name === 'overbrace') {
            $box->add($body, 1, 1);
            $box->draw('/' . str_repeat('-', $body->width) . '\\');
        } else {
            $box->add($body, 0, 1);
            if ($name === 'overline')
                $box->draw(str_repeat('_', $w));
            elseif ($name === 'vec')
                $box->draw(str_repeat('-', $w - 1) . '>');
            else
                $box->draw(['hat' => '^', 'dot' => '.', 'tilde' => '~'][$name], intdiv($w - 1, 2));
        }
        return $box;
    }
}

function buildLines(array $breaks, array $types, array $boxes, array $starts, array $params): array
{
    $result = [];
    $position = 0;
    $alignment = null;
    $breaks = array_keys($breaks);
    sort($breaks, SORT_NUMERIC);
    while ($position < count($boxes)) {
        $indent = $position === 0
            ? 0
            : (
                $alignment === null
                    ? $params['indent']
                    : (
                        $types[$position][0] === 'relation'
                            ? $alignment[0]
                            : $alignment[0] + $alignment[1] + $params['rel_space']
                    )
            );
        $ends = array_values(array_filter($breaks, fn($end) => $end > $position));
        $ends[] = count($boxes);
        $candidates = $fitting = [];
        foreach ($ends as $end) {
            $width = $starts[$end - 1] + $boxes[$end - 1]->width - $starts[$position];
            $candidates[] = [$end, $width];
            if (($indent + $width) <= $params['width'])
                $fitting[] = [$end, $width];
        }
        [$end, $width] = $fitting ? $fitting[count($fitting) - 1] : $candidates[0];
        $result[] = [$position, $end, $indent, $width];
        if ($position === 0)
            for ($i = 0; $i < $end; ++$i)
                if ($types[$i][0] === 'relation') {
                    $alignment = [$starts[$i], $boxes[$i]->width];
                    break;
                }
        $position = $end;
    }
    return $result;
}

function placeFormula(Formula $f, Typesetter $typesetter, array $params): array
{
    $nodes = $f->nodes;
    [$types, $gaps] = spacing($nodes, 'normal', $params);
    $boxes = array_map(fn($n) => $typesetter->typeset($n), $nodes);
    $starts = [];
    $x = 0;
    foreach ($boxes as $i => $box) {
        $starts[] = $x;
        $x += $box->width + ($gaps[$i] ?? 0);
    }
    $relations = $plusMinus = $punctuation = [];
    for ($i = 1; $i < count($nodes); ++$i) {
        if ($types[$i][0] === 'relation')
            $relations[$i] = true;
        if (
            $nodes[$i]->kind === 'symbol'
            && in_array($nodes[$i]->value, ['+', '-'], true)
            && $types[$i][0] === 'binary'
        )
            $plusMinus[$i] = true;
        if ($types[$i - 1][1] === 'punctuation')
            $punctuation[$i] = true;
    }
    foreach ([$relations, $relations + $plusMinus, $relations + $plusMinus + $punctuation] as $breaks) {
        $plan = buildLines($breaks, $types, $boxes, $starts, $params);
        if (array_all($plan, fn($line) => ($line[2] + $line[3]) <= $params['width']))
            break;
    }
    $roots = $overfull = [];
    $width = $height = 0;
    foreach ($plan as $i => [$start, $end, $indent, $lineWidth]) {
        $line = rowBox(
            array_slice($boxes, $start, $end - $start),
            array_slice($gaps, $start, $end - $start - 1),
            'line ' . ($i + 1),
        );
        $roots[] = [$line, $indent, $height];
        $height += $line->height;
        $width = max($width, $indent + $line->width);
        if (($indent + $lineWidth) > $params['width'])
            $overfull[] = [$i + 1, $indent + $lineWidth];
    }
    if ($f->tagString !== null) {
        $tag = $f->tagString;
        $tx = $params['width'] - strlen($tag);
        [$last, $lx, $ly] = $roots[count($roots) - 1];
        if ($tx >= ($lx + $last->width + 2))
            $ty = $ly + $last->baseline;
        else
            $ty = $height++;
        $box = new Box(strlen($tag), 1, 0, 'tag "' . $tag . '"');
        $box->draw($tag);
        $roots[] = [$box, $tx, $ty];
        $width = max($width, $tx + $box->width);
    }
    return [$roots, count($plan), $width, $height, $overfull];
}

function treeNotation(MathNode $n): string
{
    $kind = $n->kind;
    if (in_array($kind, ['identifier', 'number', 'command'], true))
        return $n->value;
    if ($kind === 'symbol')
        return "'" . $n->value . "'";
    if ($kind === 'text')
        return '"' . $n->value . '"';
    if ($kind === 'reference')
        return '(eqref "' . $n->value . '")';
    if ($kind === 'row')
        return (
            '(row'
            . ($n->children ? ' ' . implode(' ', array_map(treeNotation(...), $n->children)) : '')
            . ')'
        );
    if ($kind === 'matrix')
        return (
            '('
            . $n->value
            . ' '
            . implode(' ', array_map(
                fn($row) => '[' . implode(' ', array_map(treeNotation(...), $row)) . ']',
                $n->children,
            ))
            . ')'
        );
    if ($kind === 'delim') {
        $delimiters = array_map(fn($s) => strlen($s) === 1 ? "'$s'" : $s, $n->value);
        return '(delim ' . implode(' ', $delimiters) . ' ' . treeNotation($n->children[0]) . ')';
    }
    if ($kind === 'script') {
        [$base, $sub, $sup] = $n->children;
        $name = $sub === null ? 'sup' : ($sup === null ? 'sub' : 'subsup');
        $children = array_values(array_filter($n->children, fn($child) => $child !== null));
    } else {
        $name = $kind === 'accent' ? $n->value : $kind;
        $children = $n->children;
    }
    return '(' . $name . ' ' . implode(' ', array_map(treeNotation(...), $children)) . ')';
}

final class LinearNotation
{
    public function __construct(
        private array $params,
        private array $references,
    ) {}

    public function row(array $nodes, string $style = 'normal'): string
    {
        [, $gaps] = spacing($nodes, $style, $this->params);
        $text = '';
        foreach ($nodes as $i => $n) {
            if ($i)
                $text .= str_repeat(' ', $gaps[$i - 1]);
            $text .= $this->node($n, $style);
        }
        return $text;
    }

    private function parenthesize(MathNode $n, string $style, array $kinds): string
    {
        $text = $this->node($n, $style);
        return in_array($n->kind, $kinds, true) ? '(' . $text . ')' : $text;
    }

    private function node(MathNode $n, string $style = 'normal'): string
    {
        $kind = $n->kind;
        if (in_array($kind, ['identifier', 'number', 'symbol', 'text'], true))
            return $n->value;
        if ($kind === 'command')
            return symbolCommands()[$n->value][0];
        if ($kind === 'reference')
            return $this->references[$n->value] ?? '(??)';
        if ($kind === 'row')
            return $this->row($n->children, $style);
        if ($kind === 'frac')
            return implode('/', array_map(fn($child) => $this->parenthesize(
                $child,
                $style,
                ['row', 'frac'],
            ), $n->children));
        if ($kind === 'script') {
            [$base, $sub, $sup] = $n->children;
            $text = $this->parenthesize($base, $style, ['row', 'frac', 'script']);
            if ($sub !== null)
                $text .= '_' . $this->parenthesize($sub, 'script', ['row', 'frac']);
            if ($sup !== null)
                $text .= '^' . $this->parenthesize($sup, 'script', ['row', 'frac']);
            return $text;
        }
        if ($kind === 'delim')
            return (
                delimiterString($n->value[0])
                . $this->node($n->children[0], $style)
                . delimiterString($n->value[1])
            );
        if ($kind === 'matrix')
            return (
                $n->value
                . '['
                . implode('; ', array_map(fn($row) => implode(', ', array_map(fn($cell) => $this->node(
                    $cell,
                    $style,
                ), $row)), $n->children))
                . ']'
            );
        if ($kind === 'root' || $kind === 'overset' || $kind === 'underset')
            return (
                $kind
                . '('
                . $this->node($n->children[0], 'script')
                . ', '
                . $this->node($n->children[1], $style)
                . ')'
            );
        $name = $kind === 'accent' ? $n->value : $kind;
        return (
            $name
            . '('
            . implode(', ', array_map(fn($child) => $this->node($child, $style), $n->children))
            . ')'
        );
    }
}

function diagnostic(Formula $f, int $column, string $message, bool $warning = false): array
{
    return [
        "formula {$f->number}, column $column: " . ($warning ? 'warning: ' : '') . $message,
        '  ' . $f->line,
        str_repeat(' ', $column + 1) . '^',
    ];
}

function main(): void
{
    $params = [];
    foreach (file('input/params.txt', FILE_IGNORE_NEW_LINES) as $line) {
        [$key, $value] = explode(' ', $line);
        $params[$key] = (int) $value;
    }
    $formulas = [];
    foreach (file('input/formulas.txt', FILE_IGNORE_NEW_LINES) as $i => $line)
        $formulas[] = new Formula($i + 1, $line);
    $references = referenceTable($formulas);
    $typesetter = new Typesetter($params, $references);
    $linear = new LinearNotation($params, $references);
    $rendered = $boxes = $trees = $errors = $kinds = [];
    $totalBoxes = $maxDepth = $valid = $errorCount = $warningCount = $overfullCount = 0;
    foreach ($formulas as $i => $f) {
        if ($i)
            $rendered[] = '';
        $rendered[] = 'formula ' . $f->number;
        if ($f->error !== null) {
            ++$errorCount;
            $rendered[] = '(error)';
            $boxes[] = "formula {$f->number}: error";
            $trees[] = "formula {$f->number}: error";
            array_push($errors, ...diagnostic($f, ...$f->error));
            continue;
        }
        ++$valid;
        collectWarnings($f, $references);
        [$roots, $lineCount, $width, $height, $overfull] = placeFormula($f, $typesetter, $params);
        array_push($rendered, ...drawBoxes($roots, $width, $height));
        $entries = boxLines($roots);
        $depth = max(array_column($entries, 1)) + 1;
        $totalBoxes += count($entries);
        $maxDepth = max($maxDepth, $depth);
        $boxes[] =
            "formula {$f->number}: lines=$lineCount width=$width height=$height boxes="
            . count($entries)
            . " depth=$depth";
        foreach ($entries as [$line, $level, $kind]) {
            $boxes[] = $line;
            $kinds[$kind] = ($kinds[$kind] ?? 0) + 1;
        }
        $trees[] = "formula {$f->number}: " . implode(' ', array_map(treeNotation(...), $f->nodes));
        $text = rtrim($linear->row($f->nodes), ' ');
        $trees[] = '  linear:' . ($text !== '' ? ' ' . $text : '');
        if ($f->tagString !== null)
            $trees[] = '  tag: ' . $f->tagString;
        $warningCount += count($f->warnings);
        foreach ($f->warnings as [$column, $message])
            array_push($errors, ...diagnostic($f, $column, $message, true));
        $overfullCount += count($overfull);
        foreach ($overfull as [$number, $occupied])
            $errors[] = "formula {$f->number}: line $number is overfull (width $occupied > {$params['width']})";
    }
    $boxes[] = "summary: boxes=$totalBoxes max_depth=$maxDepth";
    ksort($kinds, SORT_STRING);
    foreach ($kinds as $kind => $count)
        $boxes[] = "  $kind: $count";
    $errors[] =
        'formulas='
        . count($formulas)
        . " rendered=$valid errors=$errorCount warnings=$warningCount overfull=$overfullCount";
    if (!is_dir('output'))
        mkdir('output');
    foreach ([
        'rendered.txt' => $rendered,
        'boxes.txt' => $boxes,
        'trees.txt' => $trees,
        'errors.txt' => $errors,
    ] as $name => $lines)
        file_put_contents('output/' . $name, implode("\n", $lines) . "\n");
}

main();

<?php

const ATOM_KINDS = ['identifier', 'number', 'symbol', 'command', 'text'];

const TERMINATORS = ['}', '&', 'newline', 'right', 'end', 'eof'];

const ARGUMENT_KINDS = [
    ...ATOM_KINDS,
    'eqref',
    '{',
    'frac',
    'binom',
    'overset',
    'underset',
    'sqrt',
    'accent',
];

const UNEXPECTED = [
    'right' => 'unexpected \\right',
    'end' => 'unexpected \\end',
    '&' => 'misplaced &',
    'newline' => 'misplaced \\\\',
];

final readonly class MathNode
{
    public function __construct(
        public string $kind,
        public array $children = [],
        public string|array|null $value = null,
        public int $column = 0,
    ) {}
}

function collapse(array $nodes): MathNode
{
    return count($nodes) === 1 ? $nodes[0] : new MathNode('row', $nodes);
}

function checkBraces(array $tokens): void
{
    $stack = [];
    foreach ($tokens as $t) {
        if ($t->kind === '{')
            $stack[] = $t->column;
        elseif ($t->kind === '}') {
            if (!$stack)
                throw new FormulaError($t->column, 'unmatched }');
            array_pop($stack);
        }
    }
    if ($stack)
        throw new FormulaError($stack[count($stack) - 1], 'unclosed {');
}

final class FormulaParser
{
    private int $position = 0;
    public ?Token $tag = null, $label = null;

    public function __construct(
        private array $tokens,
    ) {}

    private function peek(): Token
    {
        return $this->tokens[$this->position];
    }

    private function take(): Token
    {
        $t = $this->peek();
        if ($t->kind !== 'eof')
            ++$this->position;
        return $t;
    }

    private function unexpected(): never
    {
        $t = $this->peek();
        throw new FormulaError($t->column, UNEXPECTED[$t->kind]);
    }

    public function parse(): array
    {
        $nodes = $this->elementList(true);
        if ($this->peek()->kind !== 'eof')
            $this->unexpected();
        return $nodes;
    }

    private function elementList(bool $top = false, bool $index = false): array
    {
        $nodes = [];
        while (true) {
            $t = $this->peek();
            if (in_array($t->kind, TERMINATORS, true) || $index && $t->kind === 'symbol' && $t->value === ']')
                return $nodes;
            if ($t->kind === 'tag' || $t->kind === 'label') {
                if (!$top)
                    throw new FormulaError($t->column, 'misplaced \\' . $t->kind);
                $kind = $t->kind;
                if ($this->$kind !== null)
                    throw new FormulaError($t->column, 'duplicate \\' . $kind);
                $this->$kind = $this->take();
                continue;
            }
            $nodes[] = $this->element();
        }
    }

    private function element(): MathNode
    {
        $base = in_array($this->peek()->kind, ['^', '_'], true) ? new MathNode('row') : $this->nucleus();
        $sub = $sup = null;
        while (in_array($this->peek()->kind, ['^', '_'], true)) {
            $t = $this->take();
            if ($t->kind === '^') {
                if ($sup !== null)
                    throw new FormulaError($t->column, 'double superscript');
                $sup = $this->argument('^');
            } else {
                if ($sub !== null)
                    throw new FormulaError($t->column, 'double subscript');
                $sub = $this->argument('_');
            }
        }
        return $sub === null && $sup === null ? $base : new MathNode('script', [$base, $sub, $sup]);
    }

    private function argument(string $name): MathNode
    {
        if (!in_array($this->peek()->kind, ARGUMENT_KINDS, true))
            throw new FormulaError($this->peek()->column, 'missing argument for ' . $name);
        return $this->nucleus();
    }

    private function delimiter(): string
    {
        $t = $this->take();
        if (
            $t->kind === 'symbol' && in_array($t->value, ['(', ')', '[', ']', '|', '.'], true)
            || $t->kind === 'command' && in_array($t->value, ['\\{', '\\}'], true)
        )
            return $t->value;
        throw new FormulaError($t->column, 'invalid delimiter');
    }

    private function nucleus(): MathNode
    {
        $t = $this->take();
        $kind = $t->kind;
        if (in_array($kind, ATOM_KINDS, true))
            return new MathNode($kind, value: $t->value, column: $t->column);
        if ($kind === 'eqref')
            return new MathNode('reference', value: $t->value, column: $t->column);
        if ($kind === '{') {
            $nodes = $this->elementList();
            if ($this->peek()->kind !== '}')
                $this->unexpected();
            $this->take();
            return collapse($nodes);
        }
        if (in_array($kind, ['frac', 'binom', 'overset', 'underset'], true)) {
            $a = $this->argument('\\' . $kind);
            $b = $this->argument('\\' . $kind);
            return new MathNode($kind, [$a, $b]);
        }
        if ($kind === 'sqrt') {
            $index = null;
            if ($this->peek()->kind === 'symbol' && $this->peek()->value === '[') {
                $opening = $this->take();
                $nodes = $this->elementList(index: true);
                if ($this->peek()->kind !== 'symbol' || $this->peek()->value !== ']')
                    throw new FormulaError($opening->column, 'missing ]');
                $this->take();
                $index = collapse($nodes);
            }
            $body = $this->argument('\\sqrt');
            return $index === null ? new MathNode('sqrt', [$body]) : new MathNode('root', [$index, $body]);
        }
        if ($kind === 'accent')
            return new MathNode('accent', [$this->argument('\\' . $t->value)], $t->value);
        if ($kind === 'left') {
            $left = $this->delimiter();
            $nodes = $this->elementList();
            if ($this->peek()->kind !== 'right')
                throw new FormulaError($t->column, 'missing \\right');
            $closing = $this->take();
            $right = $this->delimiter();
            return new MathNode('delim', [collapse($nodes)], [$left, $right], $closing->column);
        }
        return $this->matrix($t->value, $t->column);
    }

    private function matrix(string $environment, int $column): MathNode
    {
        $rows = [[]];
        while (true) {
            $rows[count($rows) - 1][] = collapse($this->elementList());
            $t = $this->take();
            if ($t->kind === '&')
                continue;
            if ($t->kind === 'newline') {
                $rows[] = [];
                continue;
            }
            if ($t->kind !== 'end')
                throw new FormulaError($column, 'missing \\end');
            if ($t->value !== $environment)
                throw new FormulaError($t->column, 'mismatched \\end');
            break;
        }
        $last = $rows[count($rows) - 1];
        if (count($rows) >= 2 && count($last) === 1 && $last[0]->kind === 'row' && !$last[0]->children)
            array_pop($rows);
        $columns = max(array_map(count(...), $rows));
        foreach ($rows as &$row)
            while (count($row) < $columns)
                $row[] = new MathNode('row');
        unset($row);
        return new MathNode('matrix', $rows, $environment);
    }
}
